title: Atlas and Clock
author: August Delacroix
blurb: Elodie Oyelaran, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
